title: Young-Driver Step Added to a Move of Level, Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
A young-driver step is added to the difference due on a move of level where the trip itself carries a
young-driver charge. Both the guest's own trip ledger and the daily rate locked in on the trip are read from
the Keyturn Trip Booking, in which a young-driver charge appears as a young-driver surcharge charged.

- Where the guest's trips carry one or more young-driver surcharges charged over the last twelve months and the
  daily rate locked in on the trip reaches 100.00 USD, a step of 55.00 USD is added.
- Where the guest's trips carry one or more young-driver surcharges charged over the last twelve months and the
  daily rate locked in on the trip is under 100.00 USD, a step of 30.00 USD is added.
- Where the guest's trips carry no young-driver surcharge charged over the last twelve months, a step of
  0.00 USD is added.

## Both sides of the rate band, and both sides of the count

| Young-driver surcharges charged in the last twelve months | Daily rate locked in on the trip | Step added |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | 100.00 USD or above | 55.00 USD |
| One or more | 99.99 USD or below | 30.00 USD |
| None | Any | 0.00 USD |

The band is reached at its own figure: a trip whose locked-in daily rate is exactly 100.00 USD reaches it and
carries 55.00 USD where the count condition is met.

## Worked on hypothetical ledgers

A guest with two young-driver surcharges charged across their trips in the last twelve months, moving level on
a trip locked in at 145.00 USD a day, carries a step of 55.00 USD. The same guest moving level on a trip locked
in at 72.00 USD a day carries 30.00 USD. A guest with no young-driver surcharge charged in that period carries
no step on either trip.
